raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

On gfx1250, `GateLinear` sends the BF16 MoE router GEMM to `torch.mm(x, w.T, out_dtype=torch.float32)`, which runs on hipBLASLt. At router shapes the hipBLASLt kernel it picks takes 0.45–0.85 ms per call at any M. On DeepSeek-V4-Pro (61 MoE layers) that adds about 49 ms to every decode step.

This PR sends gfx1250 through the dispatch gfx950 already uses. On CDNA5+, `rocm_fp32_router_gemm` then calls AITER `tgemm` with FP32 output:

- `gate_linear.py`: tier 2 (FP32 weights) and tier 6 (BF16 weights → `fp32_router_gemm_dispatch`) are now gated on `get_cdna_version() >= 4` instead of gfx950 only. On CDNA5+ the dispatch has no token limit. The unused `is_gfx950` attribute is removed.
- `rocm_fp32_router_gemm.py`: on `get_cdna_version() >= 5`, call `tgemm.mm(x, w, otype=torch.float32)`. Validation accepts CDNA4+ and requires BF16 input and weight on CDNA5+; otherwise it falls back as before.
- gfx950 is unchanged: native kernel for small M, `torch.mm` otherwise.

For these shapes on gfx1250, `tgemm` resolves to AITER's Gluon `gemm_a16w16` with per-(N, K) tuned configs.

## Test Plan

```
pytest tests/kernels/test_gate_linear_rocm_dispatch.py \
       tests/kernels/test_rocm_router_gemm_gfx1250.py
```

- `test_gate_linear_rocm_dispatch.py`: adds two gfx1250 dispatch cases (tier 2 and tier 6 routing).
- `test_rocm_router_gemm_gfx1250.py` (new): `rocm_fp32_router_gemm` against an FP64 reference at the DeepSeek-V4 Pro and Flash router shapes, M up to 16384, including top-k expert-set agreement.

Kernel accuracy and timing were also checked standalone at the router shapes of DeepSeek-V4 Pro / Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash, Kimi-K3 and GLM-5. gsm8k was run on DeepSeek-V4 Pro and Flash.

The gfx1250 runs used ROCm's gfx1250 development branch with the identical patch applied (same patch-id).

## Test Result

**Unit tests:** all pass on gfx1250 (43 tests across both files).

**Accuracy vs FP64,** M from 1 to 16384:

| model | N × K | max abs err | top-k set flips (untied rows) |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4 Pro | 384 × 7168 | 9.3e-6 | 0 |
| DeepSeek-V4 Flash | 256 × 4096 | 5.6e-6 | 0 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash | 384 × 5120 | 6.7e-6 | 0 |
| Kimi-K3 | 896 × 7168 | 1.1e-5 | 0 |
| GLM-5 | 256 × 6144 | 7.6e-6 | 0 |

**Kernel time,** µs per call under CUDA-graph replay. Before: hipBLASLt warmed eagerly. After: tgemm.

| M | V4 Pro before → after | V4 Flash before → after | Kimi-K3 before → after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 799 → 3.7 | 450 → 3.1 | 799 → 4.1 |
| 128 | 832 → 4.1 | 467 → 3.5 | 833 → 5.6 |
| 4096 | 838 → 20.2 | 467 → 8.7 | 839 → 49.2 |
| 16384 | 857 → 68.3 | 470 → 29.3 | 1695 → 171.9 |

**End to end,** DeepSeek-V4-Pro, TP4, `vllm bench serve` with the random dataset, temperature 0, `--ignore-eos`. Builds before and after differ only in the router files.

10/29 updates:
| config | total tok/s | mean TTFT (ms) | median TTFT (ms) | mean TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8k/1k c16 | 3028 → 5968 (+97.1%) | 481 → 468 (−2.7%) | 421 → 426 | 47.12 → 23.69 (−49.7%) |
| 8k/1k c64 | 9786 → 16362 (+67.2%) | 784 → 761 (−2.9%) | 719 → 671 | 58.12 → 34.48 (−40.7%) |
| 1k/1k c16 | 737 → 1600 (+117.0%) | 385 → 365 (−5.3%) | 380 → 366 | 43.07 → 19.67 (−54.3%) |
| 1k/1k c64 | 2337 → 4116 (+76.2%) | 1132 → 1151 (+1.7%) | 1115 → 1152 | 53.72 → 30.00 (−44.2%) |

**gsm8k,** 5-shot, temperature 0, full test set (1319 questions).

DeepSeek-V4 Pro, TP4, one run per batch size, strict / flexible:

| batch size | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 0.9280 / 0.9287 | 0.9318 / 0.9340 |
| 64 | 0.9075 / 0.9075 | 0.9098 / 0.9158 |
| 128 | 0.9045 / 0.9083 | 0.9151 / 0.9196 |

DeepSeek-V4 Flash, TP2, batch size 64, mean ± sd over 4 runs, strict / flexible.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| mean ± sd | 0.9390 ± 0.0097 / 0.9428 ± 0.0072 | 0.9354 ± 0.0104 / 0.9369 ± 0.0105 |

No question was answered correctly in all 4 baseline runs and wrong in all 4 runs with the change, or the other way round. The difference is within run-to-run noise.

## gfx1250 performance test

- base = https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63217

| config | total tok/s | mean TTFT (ms) | mean TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8k/1k c16 | 1945 → 5763 (+196.3%) | 677 → 512 (−24.4%) | 73.42 → 24.50 (−66.6%) |
| 8k/1k c64 | 6765 → 16142 (+138.6%) | 912 → 789 (−13.4%) | 84.28 → 34.92 (−58.6%) |
| 1k/1k c16 | 462 → 1551 (+236.1%) | 424 → 528 (+24.4%) | 68.98 → 20.13 (−70.8%) |
| 1k/1k c64 | 1580 → 4103 (+159.6%) | 1050 → 1178 (+12.2%) | 80.03 → 30.07 (−62.4%) |

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Correctness of the gfx1250 router GEMM (aiter tgemm behind
+fp32_router_gemm_dispatch) for BF16 router weights."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+
+def _on_gfx1250() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx1250
+
+    return on_gfx1250()
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_gfx1250(), reason="the tgemm router GEMM path is gfx1250-only"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("hidden_size", "num_experts"), [(7168, 384), (4096, 256)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [1, 7, 32, 33, 256, 4096])
+def test_gfx1250_router_gemm_matches_reference(
+    hidden_size: int, num_experts: int, num_tokens: int
+) -> None:
+    # Importing gate_linear registers the dispatch custom op.
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router import gate_linear  # noqa: F401
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.rocm_fp32_router_gemm import (
+        can_use_rocm_fp32_router_gemm,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    x = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden_size, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    w = (torch.randn(num_experts, hidden_size, device="cuda") * 0.02).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    # gfx1250 takes the tgemm path at every token count, not just M <= 32.
+    assert can_use_rocm_fp32_router_gemm(x, w)
+
+    out = torch.ops.vllm.fp32_router_gemm_dispatch(x, w, False)
+    ref = x.double() @ w.double().T
+    assert out.dtype == torch.float32
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.double(), ref, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)
+    # The selected experts must not change, except on near-ties at the cutoff.
+    ref_top = ref.topk(7, dim=-1).values
+    clear = (ref_top[:, 5] - ref_top[:, 6]) > 1e-3
+    got = out.topk(6, dim=-1).indices.sort(dim=-1).values
+    want = ref.topk(6, dim=-1).indices.sort(dim=-1).values
+    assert torch.equal(got[clear], want[clear])
+
+
+def test_gfx1250_router_gemm_rejects_fp32_weight() -> None:
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.rocm_fp32_router_gemm import (
+        can_use_rocm_fp32_router_gemm,
+    )
+
+    x = torch.randn(4, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    w = torch.randn(64, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    assert not can_use_rocm_fp32_router_gemm(x, w)
